name: esports-broadcast-controller
description: Production-grade dual-window Electron and React esports broadcast controller and live OBS leaderboard overlay system for BGMI and Free Fire tournaments.
author: Esports Broadcast Production

scripts.dist:win: vite build && node scripts/validate-packaging.js --prepack && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.dist:win:nsis: vite build && node scripts/validate-packaging.js --prepack && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.dist:win:portable: vite build && node scripts/validate-packaging.js --prepack && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config electron-builder.json --publish never
